ledger.noteSeg: Pagination note (BUG-063): the per-page selector (“Show”) is stored by THIS browser as localStorage['aup-list-pagesize:<list id>'] and overrides the page default. Choosing a value ≥ the total makes the platform drop the whole paginator — including the selector itself — so no in-page control can bring it back. Recovery: clear this site's data, or delete that localStorage key, then reload.

ledger.noteSeg: 分页说明（BUG-063）：每页条数选择器（Show）由**本浏览器**以 localStorage['aup-list-pagesize:<列表 id>'] 记住，并覆盖页面默认值。选到 ≥ 总数的值会让平台移除整个分页器——包括选择器本身——页面因此无法提供回退入口。恢复：清除本站点数据，或删除该 localStorage 键，然后刷新。
